title: Place the Site in Its Era
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Sort 15 sites and objects from the trip into eight period bins, from the Bronze Age to the Ottoman period, by the date each was built.

educational.topic: Place the Site in Its Era
learningObjectives: Apply the chapter's period boundaries to assign each of 15 sites and objects on the trip to the period in which it was built, with at least 12 of 15 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The nine periods and their dates
A period name tells when, not always who

keyQuestions: When was this built, not restored?
Which period on the timeline holds that date?
Does the period name match the builder?
commonMisconceptions: A period name always names the builder.
A rebuilt or reconstructed monument belongs to the date of its reconstruction.
Everything at Troy is from the time of the Trojan War.
The Iron Age left nothing to see.
assessmentOpportunities: Explain the two trap cards: the Palace of the Grand Master and the Stoa of Attalos.
